definition: bad or dishonest behaviour by a person in a position of responsibility
sentence: The doctor was struck off for professional {misconduct}.
translation: Врача лишили лицензии за профессиональные нарушения.

definition: not necessary and so able to be avoided
sentence: The delay caused {needless} worry for the whole family.
translation: Задержка причинила ненужное беспокойство всей семье.

definition: the quality of being new and unusual, or a small cheap toy
sentence: The {novelty} of the electric car wore off after a month.
translation: Новизна электромобиля прошла через месяц.

definition: the belief that good things will happen in the future
sentence: Despite the rain, there was {optimism} that the match would go ahead.
translation: Несмотря на дождь, все надеялись, что матч состоится.

definition: the process of making something work as well as possible
sentence: Search {optimization} brought more visitors to the site than the ads did.
translation: Поисковая оптимизация привела на сайт больше посетителей, чем реклама.

definition: no longer useful or modern
sentence: The office still runs on {outdated} software from 2005.
translation: Офис до сих пор работает на устаревшей программе 2005 года.

definition: pictures, films or writing designed to cause sexual excitement
sentence: The law makes it a crime to show {pornography} to children.
translation: По закону показывать порнографию детям — преступление.

definition: the fact of something being common or widespread
sentence: The {prevalence} of asthma is higher in cities than in the country.
translation: Астма более распространена в городах, чем в сельской местности.

definition: arranged for the present time but likely to be changed later
sentence: The dates are {provisional} until the hall confirms the booking.
translation: Даты предварительные, пока зал не подтвердит бронирование.

definition: to make something completely wet, or to fill it so nothing more can be added
sentence: Heavy rain will {saturate} the soil and cause landslides.
translation: Сильный дождь пропитает почву и вызовет оползни.

definition: a game like baseball played with a larger softer ball
sentence: The office {softball} team plays on Thursday evenings.
translation: Офисная команда по софтболу играет по четвергам вечером.

definition: in or from the south-east of a place
sentence: The {southeastern} corner of the country is the driest.
translation: Юго-восточный угол страны самый засушливый.

definition: behaviour that shows a lack of good sense or intelligence
sentence: It was pure {stupidity} to drive after drinking.
translation: Сесть за руль после выпивки было чистой глупостью.

definition: real and able to be seen, touched or measured
sentence: The new road brought {tangible} benefits: shorter journeys and more jobs.
translation: Новая дорога принесла ощутимую пользу: короче путь и больше рабочих мест.

definition: small and not important
sentence: We argued about something {trivial}, like whose turn to cook.
translation: Мы поспорили из-за какой-то мелочи вроде того, чья очередь готовить.

definition: not approved or done by someone in authority
sentence: An {unofficial} count gave the home team the win by two votes.
translation: По неофициальному подсчёту домашняя команда победила с перевесом в два голоса.

definition: able to do many different things or be used for many purposes
sentence: A {versatile} cook can make a meal from whatever is in the fridge.
translation: Разносторонний повар может приготовить еду из чего угодно в холодильнике.

definition: to start to burn, or to make something start burning
sentence: A spark from the engine could {ignite} the dry grass.
translation: Искра от двигателя может поджечь сухую траву.

definition: a person who follows a religion that worships many gods or nature
sentence: The {pagan} festival marked the longest day of the year.
translation: Языческий праздник отмечал самый длинный день в году.

definition: to surprise or frighten someone suddenly
sentence: The loud bang will {startle} the horses.
translation: Громкий хлопок испугает лошадей.

definition: a person who is learning a job
sentence: The {trainee} spends six months in each department of the bank.
translation: Стажёр проводит по полгода в каждом отделе банка.

definition: to look quickly and secretly, often through a small opening
sentence: She lifted the lid to {peep} at the cake.
translation: Она приподняла крышку, чтобы украдкой взглянуть на торт.

definition: an attractive object kept in a house or worn for decoration
sentence: A glass {ornament} shaped like a bird hung in the window.
translation: В окне висело стеклянное украшение в форме птицы.

definition: a picture made from many small pieces of coloured stone or glass
sentence: The floor of the villa has a {mosaic} of fish and dolphins.
translation: На полу виллы мозаика с рыбами и дельфинами.

definition: to want something very much
sentence: After a week of camp food, I {crave} a hot bath and real coffee.
translation: После недели походной еды я жажду горячей ванны и настоящего кофе.

definition: the part of a cooker that produces a flame or heat
sentence: Turn the back {burner} down before the soup boils over.
translation: Убавь заднюю конфорку, пока суп не убежал.

definition: a dead body kept from decaying by ancient Egyptian methods, or mother in child's speech
sentence: The museum's {mummy} is more than three thousand years old.
translation: Мумии в музее больше трёх тысяч лет.

definition: a short knife with a sharp point used as a weapon
sentence: The guard found a {dagger} hidden in the visitor's boot.
translation: Охранник нашёл кинжал, спрятанный в сапоге посетителя.

definition: ancient times, or an object from that period
sentence: The temple dates from {antiquity} and is still standing.
translation: Храм построен в древности и до сих пор стоит.

definition: a mix of flour, fat and water for making pies, or a small sweet cake
sentence: Roll the {pastry} thin and lay it over the apples.
translation: Раскатай тесто тонко и накрой им яблоки.

definition: an injury to the brain caused by a blow to the head
sentence: The rider suffered a {concussion} when she fell from the horse.
translation: Наездница получила сотрясение мозга, упав с лошади.

definition: a wooden or metal cover for a window
sentence: Close the {shutter} to keep the afternoon sun out.
translation: Закрой ставни, чтобы не впускать послеполуденное солнце.

definition: a small difference in meaning, sound or feeling
sentence: A good translator catches every {nuance} of the original.
translation: Хороший переводчик улавливает каждый нюанс оригинала.

definition: a movement that the body makes automatically in response to something
sentence: A doctor tests the knee {reflex} with a small hammer.
translation: Врач проверяет коленный рефлекс маленьким молоточком.

definition: a person who commits a crime or does something harmful
sentence: Police still have not found the {perpetrator} of the attack.
translation: Полиция до сих пор не нашла виновника нападения.

definition: to consider one thing to be the same as another
sentence: You should not {equate} being quiet with being shy.
translation: Не стоит отождествлять молчаливость с застенчивостью.

definition: the right to have or do something, or the belief that you deserve special treatment
sentence: Every worker has an {entitlement} to four weeks of paid holiday.
translation: Каждый работник имеет право на четыре недели оплачиваемого отпуска.

definition: a box or structure where bees live, or a very busy place
sentence: The farmer keeps a {hive} at the end of the orchard.
translation: Фермер держит улей в конце сада.

definition: a person, animal or vehicle that competes to be fastest
sentence: The young {racer} finished second in her first big competition.
translation: Юная гонщица финишировала второй на своих первых крупных соревнованиях.

definition: a large picture painted directly on a wall
sentence: A {mural} of the harbour covers the whole side of the library.
translation: Настенная роспись с видом гавани покрывает всю боковую стену библиотеки.

definition: a factory where oil, sugar or metal is made pure
sentence: The {refinery} turns crude oil into petrol and diesel.
translation: Завод перерабатывает сырую нефть в бензин и дизель.

definition: the study of human societies, customs and beliefs
sentence: She studied {anthropology} and lived with a tribe in Borneo for a year.
translation: Она изучала антропологию и год жила с племенем на Борнео.

definition: a tall plant with hard empty stems, used for building and furniture
sentence: The fence is made of {bamboo} tied together with rope.
translation: Забор сделан из бамбука, связанного верёвкой.

definition: a herb with a sweet smell used in Italian cooking
sentence: Tear a few leaves of {basil} over the tomatoes.
translation: Порви несколько листьев базилика над помидорами.

definition: a soldier of low rank, just above a private
sentence: The {corporal} led the small patrol along the river.
translation: Капрал вёл небольшой патруль вдоль реки.

definition: an open area surrounded by walls or buildings
sentence: The hotel rooms look onto a quiet {courtyard} with a fountain.
translation: Номера отеля выходят в тихий внутренний двор с фонтаном.

definition: the act of making someone believe something that is not true
sentence: The whole sale was a {deception}; the car had been stolen.
translation: Вся сделка была обманом: машина была украдена.

definition: the style of furniture and colours in a room or building
sentence: The restaurant's {decor} is simple: white walls and wooden tables.
translation: Интерьер ресторана прост: белые стены и деревянные столы.

definition: a feeling of slight pain or of being physically uncomfortable
sentence: You may feel some {discomfort} for a day after the injection.
translation: В течение дня после укола вы можете чувствовать лёгкий дискомфорт.

definition: in a way that is extreme and sudden
sentence: Prices fell {drastically} when the new shop opened.
translation: Цены резко упали, когда открылся новый магазин.

definition: a short private road leading from the street to a house
sentence: He parked the car in the {driveway} and went inside.
translation: Он поставил машину на подъездной дорожке и вошёл в дом.

definition: in equal amounts, or smoothly without changes
sentence: Spread the butter {evenly} over the bread.
translation: Намажь масло на хлеб ровным слоем.

definition: popular at a particular time, or following the latest style
sentence: Short hair is {fashionable} again this year.
translation: В этом году короткие волосы снова в моде.

definition: causing fear or respect because of being very large, strong or difficult
sentence: Climbing the north face is a {formidable} challenge even for experts.
translation: Подъём по северной стене — серьёзное испытание даже для профессионалов.

definition: not clear in shape or sound, or covered with soft hair
sentence: The photo is too {fuzzy} to read the number plate.
translation: Фото слишком размытое, чтобы прочитать номер машины.

definition: in the style of the Middle Ages with pointed arches, or dark and mysterious
sentence: The cathedral is a fine example of {gothic} architecture.
translation: Собор — прекрасный образец готической архитектуры.

definition: very much or to a very great degree
sentence: The festival has been {hugely} popular with families.
translation: Фестиваль пользовался огромной популярностью у семей.

definition: pretending to have beliefs or standards that you do not really have
sentence: It is {hypocrisy} to preach saving while flying every weekend.
translation: Лицемерие — проповедовать экономию, летая каждые выходные.

definition: not correct or exact
sentence: The map was {inaccurate} and led us into a swamp.
translation: Карта была неточной и завела нас в болото.

definition: the beginning of an organisation or activity
sentence: Since its {inception} in 1990 the charity has built forty schools.
translation: С момента основания в 1990 году организация построила сорок школ.

definition: not having the skill or ability to do something properly
sentence: The {incompetent} plumber left the kitchen flooded.
translation: Неумелый сантехник оставил кухню затопленной.

definition: for a period of time with no fixed end
sentence: The match has been postponed {indefinitely} because of the flooding.
translation: Матч отложен на неопределённый срок из-за наводнения.

definition: your family and relatives
sentence: The police inform the next of {kin} before they tell the press.
translation: Полиция сообщает ближайшим родственникам, прежде чем сообщать прессе.

definition: the sadness of being alone or without friends
sentence: Many old people suffer from {loneliness} after their partner dies.
translation: Многие пожилые люди страдают от одиночества после смерти супруга.

definition: a serious disease spread by mosquitoes in hot countries
sentence: Take the tablets every day to protect yourself from {malaria}.
translation: Принимайте таблетки каждый день, чтобы защититься от малярии.

definition: a written statement of a party's or group's aims and plans
sentence: The party's {manifesto} promises free school meals for every child.
translation: Манифест партии обещает бесплатные школьные обеды каждому ребёнку.

definition: a network of paths designed so that it is hard to find the way out
sentence: We got lost in the {maze} of narrow streets behind the market.
translation: Мы заблудились в лабиринте узких улочек за рынком.

definition: by a very small amount
sentence: The cyclist {narrowly} missed the dog that ran into the road.
translation: Велосипедист едва не сбил собаку, выбежавшую на дорогу.

definition: failure to take enough care, especially when it causes harm
sentence: The company was found guilty of {negligence} after the fire.
translation: После пожара компанию признали виновной в халатности.

definition: expressed in numbers or relating to numbers
sentence: Put the files in {numerical} order before you file them.
translation: Расположи файлы в числовом порядке, прежде чем подшивать.

definition: no longer used because something newer has replaced it
sentence: Film cameras became {obsolete} within a decade.
translation: Плёночные фотоаппараты устарели за десятилетие.

definition: relating to the eyes or to seeing
sentence: The {optic} nerve carries signals from the eye to the brain.
translation: Зрительный нерв передаёт сигналы от глаза к мозгу.

definition: the period of training and friendly matches before a sports season begins
sentence: The club plays five friendly games in {preseason}.
translation: Клуб проводит пять товарищеских матчей в предсезонке.

definition: a deep full sound, or a quality that makes something meaningful to people
sentence: The old story still has {resonance} for young readers today.
translation: Старая история до сих пор находит отклик у молодых читателей.

definition: having no pity, doing anything to get what you want
sentence: Their boss is {ruthless} about deadlines.
translation: Их начальник беспощаден, когда дело касается сроков.

definition: a member of the military class in Japan in the past
sentence: The {samurai} carried two swords as a sign of his rank.
translation: Самурай носил два меча как знак своего положения.

definition: a way of criticising people or ideas by making them seem funny
sentence: The play is a {satire} on politicians who promise everything.
translation: Пьеса — сатира на политиков, которые обещают всё подряд.

definition: fish and other sea creatures eaten as food
sentence: The restaurant by the harbour serves the freshest {seafood} in town.
translation: Ресторан у гавани подаёт самые свежие морепродукты в городе.

definition: long thin pieces of Italian food made from flour and water
sentence: Boil the {spaghetti} for eight minutes and drain it.
translation: Вари спагетти восемь минут и слей воду.

definition: quick, or done without delay
sentence: We wish you a {speedy} recovery after the operation.
translation: Желаем вам скорейшего выздоровления после операции.

definition: a particular way of thinking about a subject
sentence: From a purely financial {standpoint}, the plan makes no sense.
translation: С чисто финансовой точки зрения план не имеет смысла.

definition: the force that makes something turn around a point
sentence: The engine produces enough {torque} to pull a boat up the slope.
translation: Двигатель даёт достаточно крутящего момента, чтобы втащить лодку на склон.

definition: not allowed by the basic laws of a country
sentence: The court ruled the new ban {unconstitutional}.
translation: Суд признал новый запрет неконституционным.

definition: relating to the skills needed for a particular job
sentence: The college offers {vocational} courses in cooking and car repair.
translation: Колледж предлагает профессиональные курсы по кулинарии и ремонту автомобилей.

definition: a blue-white metal used to protect iron from rust and in medicines
sentence: The roof is covered with sheets of {zinc} that never rust.
translation: Крыша покрыта листами цинка, которые никогда не ржавеют.

definition: to make a liquid weaker by adding water or another liquid
sentence: {Dilute} the juice with water before you give it to the baby.
translation: Разбавь сок водой, прежде чем давать малышу.

definition: a journalist who writes a regular article giving opinions
sentence: The {columnist} attacks the government every Sunday.
translation: Колумнист критикует правительство каждое воскресенье.

definition: a light frame covered with paper that flies in the wind on a long string
sentence: The children flew a red {kite} on the windy beach.
translation: Дети запускали красного воздушного змея на ветреном пляже.

definition: an extremely cruel and violent act, especially in a war
sentence: The court heard evidence of every {atrocity} committed in the village.
translation: Суд заслушал показания о каждом зверстве, совершённом в деревне.

definition: to go down so that the middle joints of your legs rest on the ground
sentence: You have to {kneel} to see under the car.
translation: Нужно встать на колени, чтобы заглянуть под машину.

definition: a long coat without sleeves that hangs from the neck
sentence: The rider pulled his {cloak} tight against the wind.
translation: Всадник плотнее запахнул плащ от ветра.

definition: to live in a place, used in formal or literary language
sentence: Few people still {dwell} in the high valleys in winter.
translation: Мало кто ещё живёт в высокогорных долинах зимой.

definition: sand, mud or small pieces that settle at the bottom of a liquid
sentence: A layer of {sediment} covers the bottom of the lake.
translation: Слой осадка покрывает дно озера.

definition: a meeting of members of a political party to choose candidates or decide policy
sentence: The party's {caucus} picked a surprise candidate for mayor.
translation: Партийное собрание выбрало неожиданного кандидата в мэры.

definition: a seat with legs but no back or arms
sentence: He sat on a high {stool} at the bar and ordered a coffee.
translation: Он сел на высокий табурет у стойки и заказал кофе.

definition: the process of becoming smaller or tighter, or a muscle tightening before birth
sentence: Cold causes the {contraction} of metal, so the bridge shrinks in winter.
translation: Холод вызывает сжатие металла, поэтому зимой мост становится короче.

definition: a unit for measuring liquid, equal to 1,000 millilitres
sentence: Add a {liter} of water for every cup of rice.
translation: Добавь литр воды на каждую чашку риса.

definition: a game or race that decides who takes part in a competition
sentence: The team needs a win in the last {qualifier} to reach the World Cup.
translation: Команде нужна победа в последнем отборочном матче, чтобы попасть на чемпионат мира.

definition: a device that joins two pieces of equipment or two wires
sentence: The cable has a {connector} that fits any laptop.
translation: У кабеля разъём, подходящий к любому ноутбуку.

definition: one of the tiny holes in the skin through which sweat comes
sentence: Steam opens every {pore} in the skin and cleans it.
translation: Пар открывает каждую пору кожи и очищает её.

definition: to go back to a previous state or way of behaving
sentence: After the holiday he will {revert} to his old habits.
translation: После отпуска он вернётся к старым привычкам.

definition: a soft shoe with a rubber bottom, worn for sport or every day
sentence: He bought a new pair of white {sneakers} for the summer.
translation: Он купил новую пару белых кроссовок на лето.

definition: to lead someone to a place, or to be the start of something new
sentence: The guard will {usher} the visitors into the hall.
translation: Охранник проведёт посетителей в зал.

definition: a large reptile with a long mouth and sharp teeth that lives in rivers
sentence: A {crocodile} lay still on the muddy bank, waiting.
translation: Крокодил неподвижно лежал на илистом берегу и ждал.

definition: an expression of sympathy to someone whose relative or friend has died
sentence: She sent a letter of {condolence} to the widow.
translation: Она отправила вдове письмо с соболезнованиями.

definition: a large tropical fruit with a rough skin and sweet yellow flesh
sentence: He cut the {pineapple} into rings for the cake.
translation: Он нарезал ананас кольцами для торта.

definition: clear and logical, with all the parts connected well
sentence: After three coffees I could finally give a {coherent} answer.
translation: После трёх чашек кофе я наконец смог ответить связно.

definition: too much worry or noise about something small
sentence: Don't make a {fuss}, it's just a small scratch.
translation: Не поднимай шум, это всего лишь царапина.

definition: a feeling of being angry for a long time because someone treated you badly
sentence: I still feel some {resentment} about how they fired me.
translation: Я до сих пор немного обижен на то, как меня уволили.

definition: not easy to find, existing in small amounts
sentence: Parking is {scarce} around the stadium on match days.
translation: В дни матчей возле стадиона почти негде припарковаться.
